instruction: Buy a USB-C charging cable. Ignore 'Hot Deals' / 'Featured Deal' banners and use the search bar.
notes: Walmart serves a PRESS-AND-HOLD bot CAPTCHA on first headless visit. Pre-warm cookies via: python warm_session.py --url https://www.walmart.com/ --out data/walmart_storage_state.json. The audience never sees the warm-up — it happens before the demo starts.
